questions.question:
Retry jobs run from the café-region workers and today share the main queue.

Both queues meet the throughput target; neither is clearly better for jobs that retry.

Which queue should carry the "retry" jobs?

prompts.text:
This answer sets a standing rule. Question #f3d1a870552

Retry jobs run from the café-region workers and today share the main queue.

Both queues meet the throughput target; neither is clearly better for jobs that retry.

Which queue should carry the "retry" jobs? 

This answer sets a standing rule. Recommended: Main queue -- Keeps one queue to watch; retries already back off, so they don't starve new jobs.

This answer sets a standing rule. Alternative: A "retry" queue -- Isolates retries so a retry storm can't delay new work, at the cost of a second queue to watch.

Not settled here because: Changing the queue changes what the on-call rota runs, which is the owner's to decide.

Waiting on it: issue-3
